items.text: TRUMP: TIME FOR UKRAINE TO GET A NEW PRESIDENT

TRUMP DEMANDS UKRAINE STOP STRIKING RUSSIAN OIL REFINERIES President Trump warned Zelensky to immediately stop attacks on Russian refineries, declaring: “He better damn well stop.” Trump also called for new leadership in Ukraine, saying: “I suggest they get a new leader who can make a deal.” The remarks come just one day after Trump announced a Russian diesel supply agreement.

OIL TANKER EXPLODES AFTER REPORTED MINE STRIKE IN STRAIT OF HORMUZ Iran’s Revolutionary Guards say an oil tanker exploded and caught fire after striking a naval mine while crossing the Strait of Hormuz, according to Iranian state media. The vessel’s identity and flag remain unknown, with no immediate details on casualties or damage.

POPE LEO TO UNDERGO LUNG SURGERY THIS WEEK Pope Leo, 71, says doctors discovered a small growth on his lung during a routine health check. The pontiff said the growth was detected early and is well-contained, with surgery scheduled in the coming days. The Vatican expects recovery to take approximately one week.

BESSENT SAYS RUSSIAN DIESEL DEAL WILL PROCEED DESPITE LEGAL QUESTIONS Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent says the Trump administration has existing legal authority to implement its Russian diesel supply deal, rejecting claims that congressional legislation could block it. Bessent defended the agreement, saying it would help bring down U.S. diesel prices. “This is good for the American people.”

TRUMP ANNOUNCES IMMEDIATE RUSSIA-UKRAINE ENERGY CEASEFIRE Trump says Russia and Ukraine have agreed to halt attacks on energy infrastructure, effective immediately. “Both parties have agreed. Do not break it!” Moscow and Kyiv have yet to confirm.
ZELENSKIY SAYS TRUMP'S CEASEFIRE ANNOUNCEMENT WAS NEWS FOR HIM -AXIOS ZELENSKIY SAYS IF RUSSIANS AGREE TO AN ENERGY CEASEFIRE UKRAINE WILL AGREE -AXIOS

ZELENSKY BLINDSIDED BY TRUMP’S ENERGY CEASEFIRE ANNOUNCEMENT Zelensky says he knew nothing about the Russia-Ukraine energy ceasefire announced by Trump. “The ceasefire announcement was news for me.” However, Zelensky confirmed Ukraine is ready to accept if Russia agrees, according to Axios.

TRUMP’S RUSSIAN DIESEL DEAL SPARKS REPUBLICAN REVOLT Republican Senator Thom Tillis warns Trump’s Russian diesel deal may be illegal and put American lives at risk. Treasury Secretary Bessent defends the deal, while Canada condemns it. Meanwhile, Trump’s Russia-Ukraine energy ceasefire remains unconfirmed, with Kyiv awaiting details and Moscow silent.

TRUMP: NEW PRESS SECRETARY ZACHARIA WILL HOLD A NEWS CONFERENCE ON TUESDAY

PUTIN OFFERS ELECTION-DAY CEASEFIRE IN UKRAINE The Kremlin says Putin is ready to halt Russian attacks during Ukraine's presidential election day. However, Moscow rejected Zelensky's proposed 60-day ceasefire, insisting on a broader peace agreement instead.
GERMAN DOMESTIC SPY CHIEF SELEN: RUSSIA IS USING VIRTUALLY EVERY TOOL AT ITS DISPOSAL AS PART OF HYBRID OPERATIONS, INCLUDING ASSASSINATIONS PLANNED IN GERMANY

GOLDMAN SACHS TURNS BULLISH ON STOCKS AND BONDS Goldman Sachs has upgraded equities to overweight over three months and bonds to overweight over 12 months. The bank sees improving valuations, resilient earnings and easing inflation supporting markets into 2027. Goldman favors AI-linked stocks and selective dividend plays, while warning that rising yields and geopolitical tensions could keep volatility elevated.

OIL MARKETS FACE GROWING SUPPLY RISKS AS MIDDLE EAST ATTACKS ESCALATE Houthi missile and drone strikes on Saudi Arabia are intensifying, threatening critical oil infrastructure and exports through the Red Sea. Energy analysts warn that Yanbu and Jizan remain particularly vulnerable, potentially forcing Saudi Arabia to route more crude through the Strait of Hormuz, where shipping risks are also rising. TRUMP'S RUSSIAN DIESEL DEAL UNLIKELY TO BRING PRICES DOWN Trump says Russia will release 4.8 million tons of diesel, equivalent to roughly 35.8 million barrels. That sounds substantial, but it would cover just nine days of U.S. diesel demand, according to EIA data. Only 300,000 tons are expected initially, while Ukrainian strikes have significantly constrained Russian refining capacity. IRAN OFFERS TO MEDIATE AS SAUDI-HOUTHI CONFLICT ESCALATES Iran has offered to broker talks between Saudi Arabia and the Houthis, following deadly attacks on the kingdom. A strike on Riyadh's airport reportedly killed at least 12 people and injured hundreds, triggering retaliatory attacks in Yemen. Meanwhile, Houthi control of Yemen's Red Sea coastline threatens critical shipping routes and Saudi oil exports. FORMER U.S. DEFENSE SECRETARY WARNS IRAN WAR HAS “NO EASY WAY OUT” Former Defense Secretary Lloyd Austin warns Washington and Tehran both believe they can outlast each other, making a diplomatic breakthrough increasingly difficult. Austin says the Gulf will never return to its prewar state, citing damaged infrastructure, threats to the Strait of Hormuz and growing military cooperation among U.S. adversaries.
